lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Oh my,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: would you look at the time?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Time flies when you're having fun.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So true.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Neon is fast asleep as well.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: She's really sawing logs... someone could try and kidnap her and I bet she still wouldn't wake up, haha.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: She's been boasting all day about how she'll show me how the ultimate vacation should be spent,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and yet she's already off in dreamland after closing her eyes for only a moment.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Swoosh, shhhhhh*

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Since it's just the two of us now, can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Why did you push back the departure date by sabotaging a ship that was so difficult to construct?
You knew...?
I don't know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I knew it from the start.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You don't have to try and hide it.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Some things just didn't add up.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: The fact that this ship we slaved over for so long and gathered all those materials for

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: suddenly breaks down, yet everyone is perfectly okay with it?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: It didn't make sense.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: The only thing I'm not sure about is whether

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: you persuaded them yourself,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: or if they noticed what you two were up to and decided to play along.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Either way, the fact that everyone agreed to your idea of postponing the departure date

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: shows to me that they agree with your reasons,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and have a deep respect for you.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So, I wanted to ask you

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: why you decided to do it.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Did you have to do it?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I thought it would be nice

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: if a miracle occurred, just this once.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: However.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Maybe not Neon, but you should know

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: what the real reason is for me not wanting to leave this island.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I am in fear.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I fear that Pepper might remember.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: That's why I have trepidations about returning to the Repair Center.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You knew, didn't you?
Yes.
No.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So you understand.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: If anyone deserves your attention,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: it's Pepper,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: not me.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Pepper is such a kind and gentle person.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: This kind of thing is something she could never imagine.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Her superior, who she trusted and respected,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: manipulated patient documents

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and turned over their brains to be made into Nikkes.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: In order to bring an end to such malevolence,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Pepper herself pushed me down the stairs.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: In the time that followed,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: she was never able to forgive herself,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and she spiraled.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You're lying.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Very well, allow me to refresh your memory.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: A long time ago,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: there was a doctor whose subordinate respected her more than anything in the world.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: This doctor was called 'The White Angel' by her patients.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: She was highly skilled, and she used those skills to save many lives.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: But still, she was not satisfied.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: No matter how much she tried, there was nothing she could do with patients who were terminally ill.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So, what do you think that doctor did?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: That doctor,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: along with corrupt government officials,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: falsified the documents of patients who were on their deathbeds.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: They extracted their brains and, without their consent,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: turned them into Nikkes, so that they would live forever.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: They would also, however, be forced to fight for the rest of their lives.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: This didn't happen just once or twice either.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Many patients were robbed of their dignity at the hands of this doctor.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Eventually, the subordinate couldn't take it anymore,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and pushed the doctor off from a high place, hoping to put an end to all the madness.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: In the time that followed,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: her guilt consumed her, and she spiraled.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: The end result is what you see now.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: What about now?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Are you going to continue pretending that you don't know?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You can't say that your intentions weren't pure.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I don't think I can even agree with that.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: The patients never consented to any of it.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I committed a grave sin, one for which there is no justification.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm not trying to justify what you did.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm just trying to prevent you from drowning in your own guilt.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm your accomplice, Mary.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: But why?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I thought I had gotten used to your caprices,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: but sometimes I just don't understand you at all.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Is your definition of "accomplice" different from mine?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: All I ever wanted was to keep my secret precisely that: a secret.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I never wanted to burden anyone else with my guilt or my sorrow.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: There has to be at least one person in this world who's willing to share that burden with you.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: But that person doesn't have to be you.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: There's no reason it doesn't have to be.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: ... Commander.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I've already crossed the line once before.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Yes, I've acknowledged my wrongdoing, and yes, I feel terrible for what I've done,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: but it's not smart to trust someone like me or to be in my corner.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: ... Can I give you a word of advice?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I would never trust someone like me.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I wouldn't reach out my hand and try to save me either.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I wouldn't go out of my way to save someone who is doomed to drown.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Nor would I push back the departure date just for them.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: And I certainly wouldn't persuade others to be a part of that plan, just to make that person happy.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: It doesn't make a lick of sense.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Because that kind of person...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Someone like that doesn't deserve to be happy.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: The best thing to do is simply leave them to their sorrow and their pain, and let them die.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You said it yourself, though.
You'll live to cure your sins.
For you, this method we have in mind is far better than anything else.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Now that you've said that, I won't forgive you if you die first.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Then let's go.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'll live

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: to redeem myself and my sins.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: That's what you said when you were on the brink of death.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: But, that's...!

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: ... Right.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I may have forgotten, even if I did say that.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Usually... I recommend just listening.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Having patience and care. Showing them "I'm on your side".

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Neon and I always had the same goal.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Zzzzz...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: We wanted to show that we were "on your side".

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: And I appreciate that.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: It's your advice and encouragement that

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: gave me the strength

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: to decide to head back to the Repair Center.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: But even so, is there a point to any of this?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: If we end up passing by those stairs again one day,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: and everything comes flooding back for Pepper...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Living my entire life wracked with guilt will become more than I can bear...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: But you swore that you would return.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: But I'm scared.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Don't be scared. I'll be there with you.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Sometimes, I think about quitting...

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: You think about it, but you don't. You'd never give up.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I can never give up.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Pepper isn't the only one involved in my story.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Even now, there are more people being turned into Nikkes against their will, thanks to the sins that I committed.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Being dragged up to the surface and forced to fight with Raptures. Being injured, feeling miserable, and losing their lives...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: All those people end up coming back to the Repair Center.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So, I...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I have to be there, no matter what.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Even if the person dearest to me ends up despising me.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Even if I'm called a monster.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Even if I've done nothing else with my life.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Looks like you already have the answer.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I knew I couldn't escape it,

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: but I never imagined this is how I'd be pulled back in.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'll listen to the answer my heart is telling me.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I will go back.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'll go back and keep the promise I made to you.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Even if it does destroy the last bit of warmth I have inside me.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: So... Will you allow the boat to set sail tomorrow?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: We can fix the broken parts together... Or—or replace it with a new one...!

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Hug Mary.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: *Sob*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: There is utter silence as I comfort Mary, who breaks down in sobs.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Together, we stare as the waves roll in and slam against the coast.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: *Swoosh swoosh*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Crashing down.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Receding.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Then crashing down again. All in the midst of that silent night.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Tonight, a promise has been made.
